1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition __and capable of sending an output to a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the output triggers a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein the physiological monitor is capable of initiating an escalated alarm if neither of the first or second alarms are acknowledged within a certain time__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

3. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

4. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

5. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type and a time that the alarm was triggered __and information about a level of escalation of the alarm and information about an acknowledgement of the alarm__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim [[18]] __16__, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim [[18]] __16__, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices.
